title: RAW_UNSCREENED: ols als Maßfeld oder fertiges Produkt
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: line-final ols at f83v.22 and ols-aiin at f104v.19 support two linked readings: a bounded measure/value field or a product/result noun.

design.scope_description: Exact ols loci and complete line frames in GDT769/GDT764; no liquid identity.
design.mechanism: Measure reading treats ols as a field head that receives a value; product reading treats ols as a finished material/result that may itself be measured.
design.unit: f83v.22 terminal ols and f104v.19 ols aiin.
design.prediction: Measure reading predicts ols occupies bounded value slots and changes position with value attachment; product reading predicts ols recurs as an independently modified result, including line-final closure without a value.
concrete_observations: GDT769 reports line-final ols positions and exact ols-aiin value contacts.
GDT764/GDT769 retain both measure/product and preparation rivals.
linked_consequences: The measure model requires a written value whenever ols is a measured field.
The product model permits line-final result use and predicts compatible process/quality modifiers across occurrences.
design.nearest_rival: A finished product/result whole that can also occur beside values.
design.distinguishing_observation: Check whether line-final ols has a stable closure role while ols-aiin behaves as a field; a single contact cannot identify the substance or unit.
assumption_costs: ols is treated as a whole form
value adjacency is formal evidence only
design.strongest_likely_failure: The two positions can be ordinary positional variants of one record word and neither supplies material identity.
